8.7. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter¶

The module defines functions and classes that return different iterators over paths.

Functions

areaIter(path, railyard[, types]) Iterator over areas of user type in types along path in railyard.
edgeIter(path) Iterator over pairs of node indices corresponding to the edges in path.
nodeConnectorIter(path) Iterator over X{node-connector}s of path.
objectConnectorIter(path) Iterator over X{object-connector}s of path.

Classes

DirObjectIter(path, facing[, types]) An iterable over directed objects in path that satisfy the specified condition.
ObjectIter(path[, types]) An iterable over all objects in a path that are of given types.
SwitchIter(path[, diverging, facing]) An iterable over switch objects in path that satisfy the specified condition.
